summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly press release for New Residential Construction, August 2022 (released September 20, 2022). Relevant to the task: It provides the seasonally adjusted annual rates (SAAR) for total building permits and total housing starts. Table 3a shows July 2022 starts at 1,404,000, exceeding the 1,300,000 threshold, identifying August 2022 as a qualifying month for the ratio calculation. Table 1a and Table 3a provide the August 2022 permit (1,517,000) and start (1,575,000) values required for the calculation. The document covers the start of the task's 2022/08 to 2025/05 window but does not contain data beyond August 2022.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release for New Residential Construction, dated October 19, 2022, covering data through September 2022 (Release CB22-174). This document provides Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) data for total building permits (Table 1a) and housing starts (Table 3a), specifically featuring revised figures for August 2022 and preliminary figures for September 2022. It is task-relevant because it allows the identification of qualifying months for the ratio calculation: July 2022 total starts (1,377,000) and August 2022 total starts (1,566,000) both exceed the 1,300,000 threshold, thereby qualifying August 2022 and September 2022 for inclusion in the average. The report supplies the corresponding permit values (August: 1,542,000; September: 1,564,000) and start values. As the latest source for this period at time of release, its revised August data should prevail over earlier reports per the task's conflict resolution rule, though it does not cover data beyond September 2022.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release for New Residential Construction (October 2022 data, released November 17, 2022). Relevant to the task: It provides Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) data for Total Building Permits and Total Housing Starts covering August through October 2022. Table 3a confirms July 2022 starts (1,377,000) exceeded the 1,300,000 threshold, qualifying August 2022; subsequent months' starts (August 1,508,000; September 1,488,000) also exceeded the threshold, qualifying September and October 2022. The document provides the corresponding permit values (August: 1,542,000; September: 1,564,000; October: 1,526,000) needed for the ratio calculation. Note that August and September data are marked 'revised' and October is 'preliminary,' so values may be superseded by later reports per the task's conflict resolution rule. The coverage ends in October 2022, not extending to the full 2022/08–2025/05 period.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (Report CB22-210) dated December 20, 2022, reporting New Residential Construction statistics for November 2022. Relevant to the task: It provides Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) data for Total Building Permits (Table 1a) and Total Housing Starts (Table 3a) covering October through November 2022, along with revised September data. October 2022 Housing Starts (1,434,000, revised) exceeded the 1,300,000 threshold, qualifying November 2022 for the average ratio calculation (Permits: 1,342,000; Starts: 1,427,000). September 2022 Housing Starts (1,465,000, revised) also exceeded the threshold, qualifying October 2022 (Permits: 1,512,000; Starts: 1,434,000). The figures are marked as preliminary ('p') or revised ('r'), indicating they are subject to the task's rule that the most recent report shall prevail (potentially superseded by the December 2022 release). The document includes a notice regarding a methodology change for the Building Permits survey beginning January 2023.
